name: DGCA Civil Aviation Requirements, Section 3 - Air Transport Series M Part IV Issue I
notes: Verified directly from DGCA CAR Series M Part IV official provisions. Covers cancellations, delays, and denied boarding for domestic and originating international flights from India.

cancellation_compensation_tiers.block_time_description: Flights having a block time of up to 1 hour
cancellation_compensation_tiers.rule: INR 5,000 or one-way booked basic fare plus airline fuel charge, whichever is less

cancellation_compensation_tiers.block_time_description: Flights having a block time of more than 1 hour and up to 2 hours
cancellation_compensation_tiers.rule: INR 7,500 or one-way booked basic fare plus airline fuel charge, whichever is less

cancellation_compensation_tiers.block_time_description: Flights having a block time of more than 2 hours
cancellation_compensation_tiers.rule: INR 10,000 or one-way booked basic fare plus airline fuel charge, whichever is less

more_than_2_weeks.remedy: Alternate flight or full refund of ticket price

between_24_hours_and_2_weeks.remedy: Alternate flight or refund of ticket value as preferred by the passenger

less_than_24_hours.remedy: Financial compensation as per block time tiers PLUS alternate flight or full refund

overnight_delay.remedy: Free hotel accommodation including transport to/from airport
